result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with a high-speed character and significant crossing distances. While a marked crosswalk and curb ramps are present on one corner, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and refuge islands creates a high-exposure environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, which can lead to confusion and unsafe crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to high-visibility continental patterns on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads that show the remaining time to cross, improving safety and compliance.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk across a multi-lane roadway, but lacks active signalization or a refuge island. The sidewalk is in fair condition with visible pavement degradation and lacks formal ADA-compliant curb ramps at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unprotected Long Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or signal control.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk and road edge are cracked and uneven, creating a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, at the start of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install user-actuated amber LEDs to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes for accessibility at the crossing point.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection in a residential area that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, requiring pedestrians to cross a long distance without protection or guidance.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to designate a safe path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cover a long distance exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible at this signalized intersection to indicate safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow for two-stage crossing.
